svg.title: What LOTUS Guard does when a device is plugged in
svg.desc: A replay in two parts. An unknown SanDisk flash drive is plugged in while removable storage is set to block, and LOTUS switches it off. A HyperX headset whose model is on the trusted list is plugged in while USB devices are set to trusted only, and it keeps working.

g.text: // WHAT HAPPENS WHEN A DEVICE IS PLUGGED IN
